metadata.title: AAO operational AI governance controls
metadata.remarks: Original local control catalog. Mappings are interpretive; this is not an official NIST or EU catalog and not a certification.

components.title: AI evidence decision engine
components.description: OPA rules evaluate operational evidence assertions. Human review determines legal applicability and evidence validity.

control-implementations.description: Selected operational checks plus human treatment review. Not full framework coverage.

implemented-requirements.description: Assign an accountable AI system owner. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Document use case, stakeholders and risk assessment. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Retain evaluation results and test limitations. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Record decisions, monitoring and retest triggers. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Record and test direct-interaction disclosure where applicable. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Test machine-readable marking and its effectiveness. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Document notice for emotion recognition or biometric categorization. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Document applicable deepfake and public-interest text disclosure. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
Test timing, accessibility and clarity at first interaction or exposure. Evidence source: policies/ai.rego; exceptions and MANAGE treatment require accountable human review.
